**[[U.S.]] [[President of the United States|president]] [[Donald Trump]] announces that the [[tariff]] on [[steel]] and [[aluminum]] [[imports]] will be doubled to 50%, potentially raising prices for housing, autos, and other goods. *[[2025 Nigeria floods]]

'''International relations'''
*[[China–United States trade war]]
**U.S. president [[Donald Trump]] accuses [[China]] of violating the temporal suspension of tariffs accorded two weeks ago, while China accuses Trump of discriminatory restrictions against the country. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cje7zex3njwo (BBC News)]
*[[Diplomatic impact of the Gaza war]], [[France–Israel relations]]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2025 Liverpool parade incident]]
**Paul Doyle, a 53-year-old British man accused of driving his car into a crowd after [[Liverpool FC]]'s trophy parade, appears at both the [[Liverpool Magistrates' Court]] and [[Liverpool Crown Court]] and faces seven charges. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c0j7exddjneo (BBC News)] [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/crime/paul-doyle-liverpool-parade-crash-suspect-west-derby-b2760482.html (''The Independent'')]
*[[Corruption in the Czech Republic]]
**[[Czech Republic]] [[Ministry of Justice (Czech Republic)|justice minister]] [[Pavel Blažek]] resigns after his ministry accepted a donation of [[bitcoin]]s and sold them for about 1 billion [[Czech koruna]] (over US$45 million) earlier this year. [https://abcnews.go.com/Technology/wireStory/czech-justice-minister-resigns-donated-bitcoin-scandal-122353284 (ABC News)]
*[[Murder of Tina Satchwell]]
**Richard Satchwell is found unanimously guilty and convicted of the 2017 murder of his wife Tina in [[Youghal]], [[County Cork]], [[Republic of Ireland|Ireland]]. [https://www.rte.ie/news/courts/2025/0530/1515840-richard-satchwell-court/ (RTÉ)]
